description: Hand-written test graph for the epileptic encephalopathy / channelopathy demo cluster. Evidence rows are fixtures (source_type 'fixture'), not real sources; nodes with attrs.placeholder_id use placeholder identifiers.

clusters.label: Sodium channel gain-of-function epilepsies
clusters.mechanism_summary: Variants that make sodium channels (SCN1A, SCN2A, SCN8A) more active, leading to early-onset seizures.

clusters.label: Sodium channel loss-of-function epilepsies
clusters.mechanism_summary: Variants that reduce sodium channel function (SCN1A, SCN2A), with fever-sensitive seizures or later-onset neurodevelopmental features.

clusters.label: Synaptic and potassium channel encephalopathies
clusters.mechanism_summary: Reduced synaptic vesicle release (STXBP1) or potassium channel dysfunction (KCNQ2) in early-onset encephalopathies.

explanations.text: Children with STXBP1 encephalopathy and children with early-onset SCN2A encephalopathy have many of the same symptoms [e_3b8845b635b8]. A patient group for SCN2A [e_0af807385728] runs a registry that families can join [e_558f7d2a940d].

Your child's condition, STXBP1 encephalopathy, shares many symptoms with early-onset SCN2A encephalopathy, such as seizures and delayed development [e_3b8845b635b8]. This is a similar experience with a possibly different cause. The SCN2A Community Alliance supports these families [e_0af807385728] and runs a registry you could ask about joining [e_558f7d2a940d].

STXBP1 encephalopathy and early-onset SCN2A DEE overlap in phenotype (seizures, global developmental delay, hypotonia, infantile spasms, feeding difficulties) [e_3b8845b635b8]; the overlap is phenotypic, not mechanistic. The SCN2A patient organization [e_0af807385728] operates a sodium channel epilepsy registry [e_558f7d2a940d] that could collect comparable natural history data.

MONDO:9900007 (STXBP1) and MONDO:9900003 (SCN2A GoF DEE) are linked by similar_symptoms (BMA 0.74, 5 shared HPO terms) [e_3b8845b635b8], an inferred edge. ORG:fx-scn2a-community serves MONDO:9900003 [e_0af807385728] and runs REG:fx-sodium-channel-registry [e_558f7d2a940d], a reusable data asset across communities.
